thread:
incident-bot: PAGED: prod-continuous-batch - severity P1 - throughput plummet in us-west-2. 90th latency > 18s, many 504s. Trigger: kv_cache.evictions spike + microbatch sizes oscillating. Link: https://monitoring/redwood/graph/abcd
Maria G: ack - I'm oncall. landing now. starting collection of logs and tailing kv cache metrics.
AJ: adding context - noticed sustained kv_cache.evictions at ~2.3M/s starting 11:02UTC, plus continuous-batch queue length rising to 4k. Likely cascade where big microbatches cause eviction storms.
Maria G: steps: 1) scale down continuous-batching max_batch_tokens to 512, 2) force microbatch cap to 4, 3) enable kvcache-protect flag to avoid prefetch bursts. I'll push config roll now.
Chris O: throwing up quick snippet for rollout:
```
kubectl set env deploy/continuous-batcher MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=512 MICROBATCH_CAP=4
# feature flag
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -p '{"data":{"kvcache_protect":"true"}}'
```
Dena: FYI customers seeing degraded completions: several enterprise customers in us-west-2 with timeouts and increased token cost. Customer-ops already notified 11:15UTC with initial heads-up.
Liam: I can run a short-lived throttle on prefetchers to dampen the kv traffic; will patch config and restart prefetch workers.
SRE-Oncall-Bot: Deploy started by Maria G - rollout id ru-20260315-11:18 - 60% canary -> monitoring.
Maria G: canary looks good at 11:22, latency 90th dropped from 18s->6s for canary hosts. However global tail still bad. Proceeding to 100%.
AJ: while rolling, we saw microbatch jitter on nodes with high QPS causing momentary batch blowups. We should also raise batching jitter floor to 30ms to reduce synchronized batch flushes.
Maria G: applied jitter floor to 30ms via config, and increased isolate-threshold to avoid cross-tenant kv storming. Re-deploying.
Chris O: logs show eviction rate dropping to 120k/s after throttle. KV cache hit ratio recovering from 55%->82% in 10m.
Dena: customer-ops update sent: initial mitigation reduced errors by ~7x, monitoring for residuals. No SLA breaches yet, but some requests retried by clients.
customer-ops: added note - two major customers reported failed requests during window 11:05-11:20 UTC. Eng to follow up with post-incident writeup.
Liam: created follow-up ticket CE-4521 to track root-cause analysis and permanent fix (adaptive prefetch backpressure + more granular eviction quotas).
Maria G: handing over to night oncall @AJ for final validation & RCA prep. I'm pausing active deploys. Oncall timeline & logs stored: https://incident/redwood/2491234567
AJ: taking handoff - I'll keep watch for 2h, run synthetic end-to-end checks, and start RCA notes. If error rate climbs >2% will page.
SRE-Oncall-Bot: Handoff logged. New oncall: AJ. Reminder: escalation path eng-runtime -> eng-infra if reverts needed.
Chris O: quick note: temporary hotfixs are config-level; long-term needs runtime KV quotas + batch shape-aware scheduler.
Maria G: thanks team. tagging for postmortem: @eng-runtime @eng-ml @customer-ops. :thumbsup:
